findings.description: The same BLOB-to-Buffer throw is still possible on two other untyped columns in the recap path. `events.created_at` reaches `sanitizeReason` through `utc()` (fix-round time at L59, last gate at L91), and `sessions.id` is passed raw at L116-120 and L178. A BLOB written to either one makes `pup session recap` or `pup conductor recap` throw and print nothing. Stringifying inside `utc()` and at the `session.id` sites would close the class of bug this PR fixes for `state`.

process_issues.description: The conventions reviewer said only the rule-file stub loaded. It did not read docs/conventions/general.md, naming.md or testing.md, so it checked the diff against AGENTS.md only and quoted no conventions rules.

The consolidator was skipped because only one finding came back, so there was nothing to merge. correctness raised that finding as important. It was retagged pre-existing before validation: the flagged lines (utc() and the session.id sites) are not among the diff's added lines, and the PR's acceptance covers sessions.state only. That left no importants, so no validator ran.
